==[[Feedback:Game updates/20120913|September 13, 2012]]==
*The exhaustion mechanic is now referred to as "[[Overcast]]."


==[[Feedback:Game updates/20120105|January 5, 2012]]==
*Reduced Exhaustion to 5; reduced damage to {{gr|10|70}}; you can now teleport to allies as well as enemies; added the following functionality: "All adjacent foes are Blinded for {{gr|1|5}} seconds."
